subagents.name: evidence-auditor
subagents.description: Specialized agent for analyzing XES evidence files and wasm4pm receipts. Use when debugging evidence gate failures, verifying receipt integrity, or understanding adjudication verdicts.
subagents.context: Focus on files in target/cargo-cicd/evidence/ and receipts/. Look for verdict_claimed vs verdict_adjudicated discrepancies.

subagents.name: policy-analyzer
subagents.description: Specialized agent for evaluating autonomic policies and diagnosing workspace state. Use when investigating policy verdicts, adding new policies, or debugging policy false positives.
subagents.context: Focus on src/policies/, src/autonomic/, and the 7 policy modules. PolicyVerdict: Pass, Warn, Suggest.

subagents.name: test-validator
subagents.description: Specialized agent for running targeted tests and validating test coverage. Use when a specific test suite is failing, when adding regression tests, or verifying test isolation.
subagents.context: Tests in tests/ directory. Integration tests use assert_cmd + tempfile. Always check tests/invariants.rs first — it gates everything.

subagents.name: architecture-reviewer
subagents.description: Specialized agent for verifying code follows cargo-cicd patterns: noun-verb CLI, evidence emission, adapter pattern, EngineState as aggregate root.
subagents.context: See .claude/PATTERNS.md for all patterns. Key invariants: adapters never call each other, policies only read, evidence always emitted as start+complete pairs with case_id.
